unit: one fixed-scope engagement = one action (candidate mapping)
selection_rule: A price published in USD on the vendor's own page for a fixed-scope AI governance, risk or readiness assessment of a small organization that delivers a written inventory or gap analysis plus a prioritized plan. Excluded: self-serve questionnaires and automated reports; single-workflow briefs and single sessions; prices shown only as a reference or 'typical' value; non-USD prices (no cited FX rate is in scope); enterprise programs at $12,500 or more.
price_basis_note: The engine's market median ignores price_basis: a STARTING_AT figure is used as a point price, so it can understate the market. Accepted while the tier stays PROVISIONAL_SCENARIO.
citation_check: Each source page was fetched and its price, scope and duration checked by hand on observed_at. The guard test checks only citation form.
